notes: Messages you send while a task is running now go through immediately — they stay in the conversation, and you have 8 seconds to cancel with ✕.
Approval buttons for sensitive files and API keys show up properly — you can hit [Apply] or [Save to vault] right on the card.
Move your working folder anywhere — the app detects the move and migrates your cards, conversations and agents in one step.
Usage readings are accurate again — we fixed a badge that drifted from your real usage, and hovering shows exactly when it resets. If your login drops, you can sign back in right there.
Failures name the real cause — no more '🪫 usage limit reached' when your limit is fine; you see the actual error (a server 500, for example).

Four emotes arrived in the Arena, and your opponent answers back. Guaranteed eggs can now roll higher grades, the share card's 'what I did today' no longer comes up empty, and pet quips went from 3 to 30.
